title: Scope.
officialText: The provisions of this subchapter shall control the design and construction of places of assembly as defined in subchapter two of this chapter. For specific classification of assembly occupancies, see article eight of subchapter three of this chapter. For place of assembly permit requirements, see section 27-525.1 of article two of this subchapter.
